description: Candidate recovery of the retained fig-10 draft, not a byte restoration or visual approval. One upward-opening schematic has one x-axis contact at the unchanged current-text value -1 2/3. Retained context: ssot-resources/soviet10year-textbooks/artifacts/8a/editions/modern-us-neutral/figures/evidence/fig-10/cap1-HOLD/context.json.txt. Coordinates are approximate source-pixel layout with inverted y, not calibrated function units. Modern additions remain semantic ink, explicit label anchors, horizontal x-axis regularization, finite piecewise-linear samples, and small landmarks embedded within existing ink. The source y-axis slant and every finite endpoint are retained. Recovery places the origin and the existing curve/y-axis intersection exactly on the declared slanted axis; no assertion tolerance is enlarged. No grid, numeric scale, extra tick, guide, formula, root marker, y-value, answer shading, or boundary extension is added. Exact original thick-stroke centerlines and numerical curvature are not claimed. Historical failed draft and all other figures remain unchanged.

authoritativeText.text: 因为三项式$9x^2+30x+25$的判别式等于0（$D=900-900=0$），所以三项式有唯一的根. 通过计算，求出三项式的根等于$-1\frac{2}{3}$. 因此，所讨论的抛物线和$x$轴只有一个公共点，它的坐标等于$-1\frac{2}{3}$. 在图10中简略地画出了抛物线$y=9x^2+30x+25$. 由图看出，当变量$x$取所有的值（$-1\frac{2}{3}$除外）时，不等式$9x^2+30x+25>0$是真不等式，也就是说，不等式的解集合是$\left]-\infty,-1\frac{2}{3}\right[\cup\left]-1\frac{2}{3},+\infty\right[$.
作为函数$y=9x^2+30x+25$的图象的抛物线的“开口”向上（$x^2$的系数是正的）.
函数$y=-2x^2+x-5$的图象是“开口”向下的抛物线.

inventory.description: Original PNG observed once in this recovery. One unframed graph has a solid right-arrow x-axis, a slightly slanted upward-arrow y-axis, and their intersection labelled O. Labels x and y identify the positive directions. The sole curve contact left of O is labelled by the negative mixed number -1 with stacked 2/3. There are no unit ticks, grid, guides, dashed branches, table, formula or y-value. Detached scan specks are not diagram objects. The retained approximate axis endpoints are used, with the origin analytically placed at their intersection rather than guessed as another independent point.

Original PNG observed once in this recovery: one solid upward-opening connected curve with two finite upper terminals, a sole minimum/contact on the x-axis left of O, and a right arm crossing the y-axis above O. No isolated contact circle, endpoint circle, curve arrow, or labelled y-intercept is printed. The retained approximate pixel samples and both interior terminals are preserved. Only the x coordinate of the existing y-axis crossing sample moves by less than one source pixel to the declared axis. Landmark ink stays embedded in existing strokes. No y scale, curvature or numerical vertex height is inferred. All mapped landmarks participate in in-group source-layout displacements.
